references.why: Elliot's radio sign-on, 'You are loved with an everlasting love', quoted at blocks 7, 24 and 25. It is her second-person, passive re-wording of the verse (SUV: 'nimekupenda kwa upendo wa milele'), so it cannot be verbatim: rendered «Umependwa kwa upendo wa milele», keeping the verse's own phrase «kwa upendo wa milele» (the corpus's wording, e.g. days-of-heaven-upon-earth.sw.json) and matching the already-shipped sw Q&A for this author.

'underneath are the everlasting arms' — the clause «na mikono ya milele i chini yako» is taken verbatim from the shipped corpus's Deut 33:27 quotation, and used identically at blocks 7, 24 and 25. (The shipped sw Q&A has the looser «chini yako pana mikono ya milele»; the bio follows the Bible wording.)
